message: a step reply: the null command (force and torque both null)
direction: controller to runner: one reply line (the envelope is written by the runner's client)
captured_from: a run of the toy self-test (controller/selftest) with a controller that sends each reply form once (kept by the maintainers, not given)
values: toy values of the self-test's toy session: nothing in this message is a value of the robot or of the acceptance sessions
